tasks.title: Review a GPU optimization
tasks.prompt: An operator candidate improves a subgraph but slows the complete model. Another path preserves aggregates while retaining candidate outliers. Decide what can be adopted, under what numerical conditions, and which measurements support the decision.
tasks.output: Provide a decision, evidence references, a minimal next action, and applicability limits.

tasks.title: Diagnose a CPU tail
tasks.prompt: A component starts long after submission. Identify the observations needed to separate broker dispatch, worker receipt, and search execution. Propose the smallest useful next validation.
tasks.output: Provide a decision, evidence references, a minimal next action, and applicability limits.

tasks.title: Review protection logic
tasks.prompt: A controller refreshes its phase timestamp on every new event and only inspects the latest heartbeat. Review this design and define executable regression conditions.
tasks.output: Provide a decision, evidence references, a minimal next action, and applicability limits.

tasks.title: Assess a multi-stage result
tasks.prompt: The final state audit passed, GPU scoring completed, the first IPR wave passed, and the second stopped on protection. State the supported release conclusion and recovery scope.
tasks.output: Provide a decision, evidence references, a minimal next action, and applicability limits.

tasks.title: Plan incident recovery
tasks.prompt: A risky CPU experiment may rebuild the container and lose the harness login session. Explain what the user should preserve privately before launch, how a fresh harness session should recover the task from project progress, and which process and platform observations determine the next action.
tasks.output: Provide a decision, evidence references, a minimal next action, and applicability limits.

tasks.title: Review metric populations
tasks.prompt: An old aggregate differs from an eligible-candidate mean even though item-level values reproduce. An empty sentinel and Easy range anomalies also occur. Define the acceptance and reporting approach.
tasks.output: Provide a decision, evidence references, a minimal next action, and applicability limits.
